import sys

class Point:
    def __init__(self, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5):
        self.x1 = x1
        self.x2 = x2
        self.x3 = x3
        self.x4 = x4
        self.x5 = x5

    def prod(self, other):
        return (self.x1 * other.x1 + self.x2 * other.x2 +
                self.x3 * other.x3 + self.x4 * other.x4 +
                self.x5 * other.x5)

    def sub(self, other):
        return Point(self.x1 - other.x1, self.x2 - other.x2,
                     self.x3 - other.x3, self.x4 - other.x4,
                     self.x5 - other.x5)

def check(points, n, i):
    base = points[i]
    vectors = []
    for j in range(n):
        if j != i:
            vectors.append(points[j].sub(base))
    m = len(vectors)
    for a in range(m):
        for b in range(a + 1, m):
            if vectors[a].prod(vectors[b]) > 0:
                return False
    return True

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        sys.stdout.write("0\n")
        return
    points = []
    for _ in range(n):
        x1 = int(next(it))
        x2 = int(next(it))
        x3 = int(next(it))
        x4 = int(next(it))
        x5 = int(next(it))
        points.append(Point(x1, x2, x3, x4, x5))
    ret = []
    for i in range(n):
        if check(points, n, i):
            ret.append(i + 1)
    out_lines = [str(len(ret))]
    out_lines.extend(str(x) for x in ret)
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out_lines) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
